杨童收回眼神，恢复了平日的冷静，开口道：

“在想，接下来，我们该去哪里找他们。”

胡九郎看向古镇深处，雾气缭绕，看不清尽头。

“桃源古镇，不是终点。”

“这里，只是一个开始。你愿意继续跟着这个案子吗？”

胡九郎摇了摇头，说道：

“我不知道，干我们这一行的，你应该知道，不能介入太多因果，其实我现在就已经过多介入了，这不好……”

杨童好奇问道：

“嗯？过多介入因果，会发生什么？”

胡九郎笑道：

“天谴！”

杨童眉毛一挑。

“没这么严重吧？这你也来？”

胡九郎看着杨童，似笑非笑。

“我给莫奇卫符篆，这算不得介入因果，但是我跟你到达夜月村，是一件非常危险的事情！”

杨童悠悠道：

“如此说来，我就不该让你来？”

胡九郎笑道：

“我自己的选择，贪图你的东西，那么就算是有什么，也是我自己的问题，跟你无关，我们还是先四处看一看，是否还有什么线索吧！”

胡九郎这时内心深处，还有一个更隐秘的念头——下山前，师父曾说，他此生会遇一段命中注定的姻缘。

眼前这个短发英气、一身正气、却在不经意间流露出温柔的女人，会不会就是师父口中的那一段？

他没有说出口，只是默默握紧了胸口的护身符。

冷欣此刻已经恢复了过来，林佳把脉之后，又在她的几处穴道施针，这让冷欣有些感激。

“谢谢你们，你们来这里做什么？”

阡陌插嘴道：

“我们是来调查异能者失踪的事情的……”

冷欣若有所思。

“陆明也属于异能者，他跑进来如果找不到，是不是也算是失踪！”

林佳眼眸一闪，说道：

“你的意思是……异能者失踪，和那个神秘女人有莫大的关系？甚至陆明如果不是你在追杀，也在异能者失踪之列？”

Yang Tong withdrew his eyes, regained his usual calmness, and said:

"I'm thinking about where we should find them next."

Hu Jiulang looked deep into the ancient town. The fog was shrouded and he couldn't see the end clearly.

"Taoyuan Ancient Town is not the end."

"This is just the beginning. Are you willing to continue following this case?"

Hu Jiulang shook his head and said:

"I don't know. In our line of work, you should know that you can't get involved too much in cause and effect. In fact, I've already gotten involved too much, which is not good..."

Yang Tong asked curiously:

"Huh? What will happen if you get too involved in cause and effect?"

Hu Jiulang smiled and said:

"God damned!"

Yang Tong raised his eyebrows.

"It's not that serious, right? Are you coming too?"

Hu Jiulang looked at Yang Tong, half smiling.

"I gave Mo Qi the talisman seal. This is not an intervention in cause and effect, but it is a very dangerous thing for me to arrive at Yeyue Village with you!"

Yang Tong leisurely said:

"So, I shouldn't let you come?"

Hu Jiulang smiled and said:

"It's my own choice to covet your things, so even if there is something, it's my own problem and has nothing to do with you. Let's take a look around first to see if there are any clues!"

Deep in Hu Jiulang's heart at this time, there was a more secret thought - before going down the mountain, his master once said that he would meet a destined marriage in this life.

Could the woman in front of me with short hair, heroic spirit, uprightness, and gentleness inadvertently be the one the master mentioned?

He didn't say anything, but silently held the amulet on his chest tightly.

Leng Xin had recovered by now. After taking her pulse, Lin Jia applied acupuncture on several of her acupuncture points, which made Leng Xin feel grateful.

"Thank you, what are you doing here?"

Qian Mo interjected:

"We are here to investigate the disappearance of superpowers..."

Leng Xin was thoughtful.

"Lu Ming is also a person with superpowers. If he can't be found when he comes in, is he still missing?"

Lin Jia's eyes flashed and she said:

"You mean... the disappearance of the superpowers has something to do with that mysterious woman? Even Lu Ming would have been among the missing superpowers if you hadn't been chasing him?"
